en: Black‑and‑white image of a large neoclassical stone courthouse with rusticated masonry, a prominent central portico supported by tall Corinthian columns, and a domed clock‑tower or cupola rising above the roof. Broad steps lead up to the main entrance, and a tall empty flagpole stands in front. The pediment above the columns is inscribed with the words 'COURT HOUSE'. Mature trees frame the building on both sides.
